verdict.rationale: GoDaddy offers no native automation builder or scheduler. The only built-in autonomous background behavior is the domain auto-renew flag, which 'fires before expiration' [godaddy-docs-5]. Users can build their own unattended automations on top of PAT-authenticated REST APIs, the gddy CLI and agent skill, and domain lifecycle notifications, but they must host and schedule these themselves. Missing for 10: native user-configurable background automations or scheduled workflows, triggers/webhook-driven actions, agent-run background jobs, and independent corroboration.
